rv.q: Reuniting with siblings Richard (Jay O. Sanders), Barbara (Maryann Plunkett), Marian (Laila Robins), and Jane (Sally Murphy) on this week’s midterm election night is a much-needed emotional salve.
But who better to spend it with than the Apples?
Their years of building these people with Nelson have created an intimacy and familiarity that you're not likely to find anywhere else.
What Nelson’s little bubble of a play proves is that the mere act of coming together, in a theater or over a dining room table, may be the best defense against despair.

cn.t: Critics warmly welcome the Apple family's return, praising Nelson's intimate real-time chronicle of American life through this beloved Rhinebeck clan, with strong performances capturing the anxiety of another fraught election night.
